title: Chinese Casserole with Avocado Salsa
description: A unique and flavorful Chinese-inspired casserole dish served with a creamy avocado salsa.
instructions: Cook the casserole noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tbsp of olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the ground pork and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the soy sauce, ginger, and garlic to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the pork mixture.
Transfer the noodle mixture to a baking dish and top with sesame seeds.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
While the casserole is baking, make the avocado salsa by mashing the avocado in a bowl with a fork.
Stir in the chopped scallions and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the casserole hot with a dollop of avocado salsa on top.
